scope: Read-only audit of what the 6.6 DPMAIF layer needs from the device tree and from the clock tree on op6893, and what this mainline tree already provides. No driver was written and no kernel behaviour changed.

capability.source: hif/ccci_dpmaif_com.c dpmaif_init_cap() falls back to 0x4 when mediatek,dpmaif-cap is absent, annotated as the MT6893 official value; the 4.19 mt6893.dts property mediatek,dpmaif_capability = <14> is not read by the 4.19 DPMAIF driver at all (no of_property_read for it in ccci_hif_dpmaif.c)
consequences: MODEM_CAP_LRO (1 << 4) off and MODEM_CAP_2RXQ (1 << 5) off, so real_rxq_num = 1 and max_pit_seq = 0xFE
MODEM_CAP_USE_RESV_MEM (1 << 6) off, so ccci_dpmaif_resv_mem_init() returns immediately and no mediatek,dpmaif-resv-cache-mem / mediatek,dpmaif-resv-nocache-mem nodes are required
MODEM_CAP_USE_MAX_BAT (1 << 7) off, so the alloc threshold stays at its default

v2_init_order: dpmaif_init_register: of_iomap reg 0 as ao_ul_base, ao_dl_base = ao_ul_base + 0x400, reg 1 as pd_ul_base, plus the infracfg regmap
dpmaif_init_cap: capability, rxq count, max_pit_seq, dl_bat_entry_size (0 when absent)
spd qos init, ccci_hif_register, ccmni_ops.send_skb = dpmaif_tx_send_skb_to_md, net_speed init

drv2_is_thin.what_it_does: sets three derived bases and wires function pointers; no board-specific register sequence
drv2_is_thin.bases: ao_md_dl_base = ao_ul_base + 0x800, pd_rdma_base = pd_ul_base + 0x200, pd_wdma_base = pd_ul_base + 0x300
drv2_is_thin.reading: the v2 file is wiring, not policy; the shared com/bat files carry the real work

dpmaif_node.needed: four register ranges (AO_UL 0x10014000, PD_UL 0x1022d000, PD_MD_MISC 0x1022c000, SRAM 0x1022e000) and GIC_SPI 209
dpmaif_node.mainline_state: absent; no dpmaif node exists anywhere in arch/arm64/boot/dts/mediatek/mt6893*

infracfg_regmap.needed_for: INFRA_DPMAIF_CTRL_REG at 0xC00 in infracfg_ao: set DPMAIF_IP_BUSY_MASK (0x3 << 12) and clear bit 13 (MD to AP wakeup); identical in 4.19 and 6.6
infracfg_regmap.mainline_state: the modem node already carries mediatek,infracfg = <&ufs_infracfg> (syscon@10001000, mediatek,mt6893-infracfg_ao), so a dpmaif node can point at the same phandle; no new node needed

vendor_needs: CLK_IFRAO_DPMAIF (4.19 id 39): gate ifrao_dpmaif_ck, parent axi_ck, ifrao3 bank shift 3
CLK_IFRAO_DPMAIF_MAIN (4.19 id 74): gate ifrao_dpmaif_main, parent dpmaif_main_ck, ifrao4 bank shift 26
CLK_TOP_DPMAIF_MAIN (4.19 id 171) and CLK_TOP_DPMAIF_MAIN_SEL (4.19 id 243) for the mux behind dpmaif_main_ck
clocks.gate_register_offsets: ifrao3 set/clr/sta = 0xa4/0xa8/0xac, ifrao4 = 0xc0/0xc4/0xc8 (clk-mt6885.c, same infracfg_ao block)
clocks.mainline_state: none of these exist: include/dt-bindings/clock/mt6893-clk.h has no CLK_IFRAO_DPMAIF, no CLK_IFRAO_DPMAIF_MAIN and no CLK_TOP_DPMAIF_MAIN, and drivers/clk/mediatek/clk-mt6893-pmif.c has no DPMAIF gate entry
clocks.reading: this is the one real gap on the clock side: two gate entries, two mtk_gate_regs tables and three binding IDs, all with known numbers

vendor_lookups_that_do_not_apply.mediatek,mddriver: both 4.19 and 6.6 read md_generation and ccci-infracfg from a mediatek,mddriver node; this tree has realme,op6893-modem-platform instead and already knows the generation is 6297
vendor_lookups_that_do_not_apply.dl_bat_entry_size: absent, so the driver uses DPMAIF_DL_BAT_ENTRY_SIZE

salvaged_artifacts.reason: these existed only under /tmp and are the only copies

files.content: first 64 KiB of the md1img partition; FILE_INFO names k6893v1_64_k419_20615S_MDBIN_PCB01_MT6893_S00.MOLY_NR15_R3_TC16_S_PR2_SP_V2_P88.bin, which matches the SWVersion in the MD's own exception dump
the untruncated adb dd stream, including the toybox record summary; recovery/android-boot-current.img (d8c9c35f...) is the truncated 32 MiB form already documented in android-boot-recovery.json

conclusion.portable_without_new_subsystems: yes; the only missing pieces are a device tree node and two clock gates, both with numbers taken from the same-board trees
conclusion.not_needed: reserved-memory regions, a second RX queue, LRO, and the MAX_BAT threshold
conclusion.gate_model_fits: resolved during the audit: the mainline ccif_gate_regs pair 0x88/0x8c/0x94 is exactly the 4.19 ifrao1_cg_regs, so the two DPMAIF gates follow the same table as ifrao3 0xa4/0xa8/0xac and ifrao4 0xc0/0xc4/0xc8, and the existing CLK_IGNORE_UNUSED + observed-parent policy covers them without changing any SCP-owned gate state
